description: Tests whether decoupled weight decay helps by keeping the head's effective step from shrinking. The head is Linear+L2-normalize, so the loss is scale-invariant in (W,b); without decay ||W|| grows and Adam's ~lr-sized steps turn the direction by less and less. Replays Phase-1 cars/lrml/lrml_ms trial 66 (best, lr 7.4e-5, 64:4) with Adam wd=0 (the tuned control) against AdamW wd in {1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1}. Every run logs --log_head_dynamics: ||W||, ||dW|| and ||dW||/||W|| per epoch in diagnostics.csv.
name: cars_lrml_ms_weight_decay
